page_title: NOT 0-1 EVE | Nottingham Forest v Everton 02/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's the end of the match.
90+3' Callum Hudson-Odoi (Nottingham) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
90+1' Chermiti (Everton) latches on to a through ball inside the box, but one of the defenders steps in with a timely interception. It could have been a great chance otherwise.
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

89' What a chance that is! Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) finds himself unmarked in a promising position after receiving a cross on the edge of the box and his attempt sails a whisker wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Everton.
87' Murillo (Nottingham) unleashes a rocket of a shot towards the right side of the goal, but the goalkeeper denies his attempt with a stunning save.
85' Nottingham are playing some nice combination football, sending it precisely from player to player, but a defender shows good anticipation and ends the move with a good block.
82' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Divock Origi (Nottingham) replaces Harry Toffolo.
82' Sean Dyche has decided to make a change. Chermiti (Everton) replaces Beto.
81' A clumsy foul by Felipe (Nottingham) and Paul Tierney blows his whistle.
78' Ryan Yates (Nottingham) misses a good chance to score. An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Ryan Yates (Nottingham) who rises for a header, but sends the ball well over the bar.
77' Callum Hudson-Odoi (Nottingham) plays a through ball but overhits it.

75' Serge Aurier (Nottingham) times his run and jump perfectly to get on the end of the resulting corner, but the ball comes off the top of his head and goes miles over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Everton.
75' Nottingham earn a corner.
74' The corner is swung in but Nottingham can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away. The ball goes out of play. Nottingham are awarded a corner kick.
73' Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) collects the ball from the free kick and immediately sends his close-range effort narrowly wide of the right post!
72' Dwight McNeil (Everton) makes his forward run a little too early and is caught in an offside position after his teammate tries to play a pass to him.

70' Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) gets in a good position inside the box and is only inches away from getting on the end of a through ball from the edge of the area. The ball is behind the touchline and Everton will take a throw-in.
67' 0 - 1 An astonishing goal by Dwight McNeil (Everton), who reacts quickly and shows great awareness inside the box. He slams the ball into the top right corner of the net.
65' A substitution has been made. Ibrahim Sangare goes off and Callum Hudson-Odoi (Nottingham) comes on.
65' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging.
63' James Tarkowski picks out Beto (Everton), who makes a total mess of his shot from mid-range and sends the ball high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Nottingham will have a goal kick.
62' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Everton.
58' Vitali Mykolenko (Everton) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
58' A brilliant through ball from James Tarkowski (Everton) as he picks out Vitali Mykolenko, who darted into free space to take the pass.
57' Everton take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
55' Paul Tierney shows a yellow card to Felipe (Nottingham) for his blatant foul.
54' Felipe (Nottingham) looks on in disbelief after missing his chance. He fires the rebound onto the right post! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Everton.
54' Nottingham have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
53' The ball is cleared after Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The linesman makes the right call and Nottingham will have a corner.
51' The free kick is delivered by Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) but it's not one of his best and is easily cleared.
49' Everton are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
46' Steven Cooper has made a change at the break. Felipe has come on in place of Willy Boly (Nottingham).
46' Paul Tierney blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+6' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+5' Abdoulaye Doucoure (Everton) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball.
45+4' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) is first to react to a loose pass inside the box, but slices his shot just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Everton.
45+3' Paul Tierney blows his whistle and it's James Garner (Everton) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
45' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
43' Dwight McNeil (Everton) connects with an accurate pass inside the box and fires the ball to the bottom right corner, but one of the defending players steps in to block the effort.
41' Abdoulaye Doucoure (Everton) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
40' Idrissa Gueye (Everton) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates. It's a throw-in for Nottingham.
35' Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
35' Nottingham can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

35' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) plays a dangerous chip pass into the box in an attempt to set up one of his teammates, but the effort is intercepted by one of the defenders. The ball is out of play. Nottingham will have a chance to score from a corner.

31' Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) misses a great chance! He latches on to a fine cross into the box, but his effort misses the right post by a whisker. The ball goes out of play and Everton will have a goal kick.
27' Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Jordan Pickford intercepts the ball.
25' Paul Tierney couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Serge Aurier (Nottingham) and blew his whistle.

22' The defence just can't clear the ball and a rebound eventually falls to Beto (Everton) deep inside the box, but his well-hit shot flies just over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Nottingham.
21' Everton enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
19' Willy Boly (Nottingham) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision! A free kick to Everton.
15' Ashley Young (Everton) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
11' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Nottingham, is intercepted by one of the defenders.

10' Vitali Mykolenko (Everton) is unable to control an accurate defence-splitting pass properly and one of the defending players reacts well to rob him of the ball. The ball goes out of play and Nottingham will have a goal kick.
9' Dwight McNeil (Everton) swings in a cross from the corner, but Odysseas Vlachodimos reads it well and gathers the ball.
9' Dwight McNeil (Everton) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball is out of play. Everton win a corner kick.
6' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
5' Vitali Mykolenko (Everton) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
3' Chris Wood (Nottingham) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger.
2' Beto (Everton) is adjudged offside.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out at last! Nottingham will take the kick-off.
Paul Tierney will supervise the game today.
